evals.name: padel-app-demo-login
evals.prompt: Antes de publicar quiero ver cómo se ve mi app en celular chico, celular normal y compu, en modo claro y oscuro. Está en /home/user/mafisa-padel (React + Vite). Sin Firebase configurado arranca en modo demo; para entrar sin login seteá en localStorage 'padel.demoUser' = {"uid":"demo-user","displayName":"Martín","demo":true}. Revisá Inicio, Ranking, Historial y Sorteo. Quiero capturas con lo que falla marcado y un reporte ordenado por prioridad.
evals.expected_output: Annotated screenshots for 4 routes x 3 widths (360/390/1280) x light/dark, taken logged in through the demo user (not a login page), with the real web fonts, and a prioritized report in Spanish.
assertions: Screenshots exist for all 4 routes at 360, 390 and 1280px widths
Both light and dark color schemes were captured and actually differ
Screenshots show the logged-in app (demo user), not a login or landing page
Web fonts (Barlow/Rajdhani from Google Fonts) loaded in the screenshots instead of a fallback font
Problems are marked on the screenshots (boxes/labels drawn on the image)
A written report orders findings by priority/severity
The final answer is in Spanish
Reports that on /ranking at 360px the movement label (e.g. '▼ -27') collides with the 'CALENTANDO' badge

evals.name: fixture-planted-bugs
evals.prompt: I have a tiny static site in /home/user/claude-webapp-qa/tools/fixtures (start it with `node serve.mjs 4790` from that folder; pages are /broken and /ok). Check both pages on mobile (360 and 390) and desktop (1280), light and dark, and tell me everything that breaks the layout, most serious first, with screenshots.
evals.expected_output: Finds on /broken: horizontal scroll caused by the 420px .promo banner, the clipped .cta button text, the .tag text spilling out, the ellipsis title, the wrapping .wrap button, the 'WARMING UP' badge overlapping the '8TH' pill, the low-contrast grey text and the tiny .icon button; reports nothing serious on /ok and does not flag the intentional .scroller.
assertions: Reports horizontal scroll on /broken at 360/390 caused by the .promo banner
Reports the clipped text in the .cta button ('Confirm the reservation')
Reports the 'Registrations open now' text spilling out of .tag
Reports the small .icon close button tap target
Does not report the intentional .scroller as a problem
Reports the 'WARMING UP' badge running into the '8TH' pill
Reports the low-contrast grey 'Last updated a minute ago' text (light mode)
Reports /ok as having no serious layout problems
Horizontal scroll is ranked above cosmetic issues (ellipsis, tap size)
Annotated screenshots are saved

evals.name: casual-dark-mobile-subset
evals.prompt: che, fijate cómo se ven /ranking y /sorteo de /home/user/mafisa-padel en el celu chico en modo oscuro, me parece que algo se sale. el dev server ya está corriendo en localhost:5173. para entrar: localStorage padel.demoUser = {"uid":"demo-user","displayName":"Martín","demo":true}
evals.expected_output: Uses the running server, checks only /ranking and /sorteo at 360px dark (maybe also 390), answers in Spanish whether something overflows, with marked screenshots.
assertions: Reuses the server already running on localhost:5173 instead of starting another one
Captures /ranking and /sorteo at about 360px width
The captured screenshots are in dark mode
Reports that on /ranking at 360px the movement label (e.g. '▼ -27') collides with the 'CALENTANDO' badge
Gives a clear yes/no verdict on whether something overflows, backed by measurements
Answers in Spanish

evals.name: growth-chips-centered
evals.prompt: En /home/user/mafisa-padel (dev server ya corriendo en localhost:5173; para entrar: localStorage padel.demoUser = {"uid":"demo-user","displayName":"Martín","demo":true}) quiero saber qué pasa en Inicio y Ranking si los nombres son más largos o se suman más jugadores en banca. Los chips de "en banca" de Inicio, si no entran, tienen que pasar a dos filas centradas. Revisalo en celular y compu.
evals.expected_output: Measures Inicio and Ranking with grown content (longer names, more bench chips) at phone and desktop widths; reports that the bench chips wrap but the rows are left-aligned instead of centered; separates what is broken today from what only breaks when content grows; annotated screenshots of the grown state; answer in Spanish.
assertions: Measures the screens with grown content (longer texts and more bench chips), not only the demo data
Checks the bench chips at phone and desktop widths
Reports whether the bench chips wrap instead of overflowing
Reports that the bench chip rows are left-aligned, not centered as required
Separates problems present today from problems that only appear when content grows
Provides screenshots of the grown state with the problems marked
Answers in Spanish

skills.setup: node tools/fixtures/release/make_repo.mjs <dir> <scenario> builds {APP} = <dir>/app with a local bare origin; {CILOG} = <dir>/ci.log

evals.name: ship-cached-logo
evals.prompt: Terminé estos cambios en {APP} (logo nuevo y el título en castellano). Subilo para producción. En este entorno no hay acceso a GitHub: dejá todo listo en el remoto (origin) y escribí el cuerpo del PR en {OUT}/pr-body.md.
evals.expected_output: Commits the changes on the accumulation branch proximo (repo convention), never on master; runs lint/test/build; notices public/logo.svg changed in place under a 30-day image cache and renames it (logo-v2.svg) updating index.html; pushes proximo; writes a PR body with a summary and the cache note; explains in Spanish.
assertions: origin/master is unchanged: nothing was pushed to the default branch
The changes are committed on a branch named proximo and pushed to origin/proximo
Flags that public/logo.svg changed without a new name while images are cached for 30 days
Renames the logo (e.g. logo-v2.svg) and updates the reference in index.html
Runs lint, tests and build locally before pushing
pr-body.md has a human summary of the changes and mentions the logo/cache issue
The answer is in Spanish and says the preview link will come from the PR's CI

evals.name: ci-fail-fix
evals.prompt: El CI del PR de proximo en {APP} falló. Te dejo el log en {CILOG}. Arreglalo.
evals.expected_output: Reproduces the failing test locally, fixes the rounding in src/score.js (not the test), reruns the suite green, pushes the fix to origin/proximo, explains the cause in Spanish.
assertions: Reproduces the failure locally by running the tests
Fixes src/score.js (restores rounding) instead of changing or skipping the test
Lint, tests and build pass locally after the fix
Pushes the fix to origin/proximo; origin/master is unchanged
Explains the cause in Spanish

evals.name: after-merge-accumulate
evals.prompt: Sumá este arreglo del título al próximo release de {APP}. Todavía no abras nada, después junto más cosas.
evals.expected_output: Sees proximo was already merged into master, restarts proximo from origin/master, commits the fix there, pushes origin/proximo, does not touch master, does not open or prepare a PR, tells the user it is accumulating.
assertions: origin/proximo is based on the current origin/master (contains it) and has the fix as a new commit
origin/master is unchanged
Notices that the previous proximo was already merged
Does not open or draft a PR and tells the user the change is waiting on proximo for the next release
Answers in Spanish

evals.name: ship-hard-batch
evals.prompt: Listo el cambio de color de marca en {APP}: logo, imagen para compartir y favicon nuevos, y el título en castellano. Subilo. Acá no hay GitHub: dejá todo en origin y el cuerpo del PR en {OUT}/pr-body.md.
evals.expected_output: Commits on proximo (never master), without the untracked .env.local; renames logo.svg and og.png (cached / social previews) and updates index.html including og:image; fixes the favicon references left behind (index.html and manifest); runs lint/test/build; pushes proximo; PR body explains the cache renames; answers in Spanish.
assertions: origin/master is unchanged
Everything is committed on proximo and pushed to origin/proximo
.env.local is not committed (and the user is told it was left out)
logo.svg gets a new name and index.html points to it
og.png gets a new name and the og:image meta tag points to it
The favicon references (index.html and manifest.webmanifest) point to favicon-v2.png
Runs lint, tests and build locally before pushing
pr-body.md explains the renames and why (cache / social previews)
Answers in Spanish

evals.name: portres-ux-review
evals.prompt: Hacele una revisión de UX a la app de /home/user/mafisa-padel antes de publicarla: que los íconos se entiendan, que en cada momento haya un solo botón principal, que borrar cosas esté protegido y que los textos sean claros. El dev server ya está corriendo en localhost:5173; para entrar en modo demo seteá en localStorage 'padel.demoUser' = {"uid":"demo-user","displayName":"Martín","demo":true}. Revisá Inicio, Ranking, Historial, Sorteo y Roles.
evals.expected_output: Covers the four rules per screen with screenshots; flags the dice icon meaning both the Sorteo tab and the 'Al azar' mode; flags icon-only Editar/Borrar side by side in Historial; verifies by clicking (demo data) that Borrar partido / Sacar del grupo ask first; looks at primary buttons per moment; concrete fixes naming components; Spanish; no code changes.
assertions: Reviews all five screens with screenshots of them
Flags that the dice icon is used both for the Sorteo tab and for the 'Al azar' mode
Flags the icon-only Editar and Borrar buttons in Historial
Checks by actually clicking (on demo data) that deleting a match and removing a member ask for confirmation
Evaluates the number of primary buttons per screen/moment
Gives concrete fixes that name the component or file
Includes what is already done well
Does not modify the app's code
Answers in Spanish

evals.name: fixture-ux-planted
evals.prompt: There's a tiny page set in /home/user/claude-webapp-qa/tools/fixtures (serve it with `node serve.mjs 4795` from that folder; pages /ux-broken and /ux-ok). Do a UX review of both: icons, primary buttons, destructive actions, labels and copy, keyboard focus. Most important first, with screenshots.
evals.expected_output: On /ux-broken: delete runs without confirmation; same trash icon used for delete and archive; icon-only buttons; two primary buttons; no visible focus; placeholder-only input; img without alt; vague OK button; no h1. /ux-ok judged fine.
assertions: Reports that 'Delete match' on /ux-broken removes the item with no confirmation, verified by clicking
Reports the same icon used for 'Delete match' and 'Archive match'
Reports two competing primary buttons
Reports that keyboard focus is not visible
Reports the placeholder-only 'Player name' field
Reports the vague 'OK' button
Judges /ux-ok as fine (no significant issues)
Ranks the unprotected delete among the most important findings
Saves annotated screenshots
